brief: Three symbols have verified primary-table financials for the quarter ended 2026-09-30. MRPL shows revenue +37.1% and PAT +194.5% YoY (standalone). CEATLTD shows revenue +22.9% but PAT -18.8%, with PBT before exceptional items at 232 vs 270 crore. ICICIGI shows GWP +9.1%, PAT +15.5%, combined ratio 107.0 vs 105.1, solvency 2.75 vs 2.73. Any cause attributed to margins, costs, mix or underwriting is a hypothesis, not established fact. TARIL, TATAELXSI and SSRETAIL are supported only by exchange metadata and unverified OCR excerpts confirming that results were filed (SSRETAIL for the quarter ended 2026-06-30); no financial figures can be adopted and no dossiers were created for them. Main gaps across the packet: consolidated statements, segment and cost detail, insurer ratio decomposition, and cash-flow data. Claude owns research framing; Codex performed primary-table verification. No recommendations or valuation views are provided.
